summary: ONEOK, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that on August 28, 2026 it, alongside subsidiaries Falcon TopCo and ONEOK Holdings, entered a contribution agreement with AP Falcon Holdings LLC, an Apollo Global Management affiliate. Apollo contributes $9 billion cash for 900,000,000 Holdings Class B Units, while Falcon TopCo contributes 100% of ONEOK, L.L.C. equity for 6,023,076,923 Holdings Class A Units. Closing, targeted on or after September 10, 2026, requires the Reorganization and customary conditions; 60-day outside date. The structure effectively monetizes a minority stake in ONEOK's operating subsidiary at a $10 billion implied valuation, with an amended Holdings LLC agreement. Watch for closing mechanics, Apollo unit governance rights, and any overhang or leverage implications for OKE holders.
